title: UG
description: HATCH, RAISE, RIDE DINOSAUR. HELP FRIEND TRADE, FIGHT BOSS. FRIEND DIE. NO LAUGH. NOT FUNNY... OKAY MAYBE SMALL LAUGH.

title: Animal Company
description: Animal Company is a FREE multiplayer social VR survival game on Meta Quest, where monsters, gadgets, and chaos with friends collide. With weekly updates, there’s always something new to explore, unlock, or break.

title: Gorilla Tag
description:
Run, climb, and jump with other gorillas using only your hands. No buttons, no teleportation. Push off of surfaces to jump and squeeze them with both hands to climb.

Explore the OG maps (Forest, Canyon, Mountain, Beach, and more) as well as new experiments (Ghost Reactor, Hoverboard Racing, Monke Ball, Prop Hunt) and player-created maps in virtual VR.

Express yourself with flair.  A rotating inventory of Cosmetic items are available at the shop in the City.

Reject humanity, become monke.

title: Airport Security Guard
description:
"BECOME A FEARLESS SECURITY GUARD AND CONTROL THE CHAOS! 😈✈️

The airport just got bigger! Explore the new Baggage Claim area, recover suspicious luggage, stop smugglers, and keep passengers moving. 

Team up with your Patrol Partner 🐶🐾, use powerful sabotage tools to outsmart rival guards, and turn every chaotic shift into your chance to climb the ranks. 💥"

title: Yeeps
description: Unlimited VR action and creation awaits in Yeeps! Master 8+ modes like Hide & Seek, Prop Hunt, and PvP. Wield powerful gadgets like grappling hooks and guided missiles, or share them with friends! Build tactically mid-match or create entire dynamic worlds from the ground up. Dive into an endless universe of player-created content in Community Worlds! Non-stop bi-weekly updates add new ways to build and play.

title: VAIL
description:
The highest-rated VR shooter is FREE. VAIL delivers precision-crafted gunplay, 10+ competitive modes, and a massive free Extraction island. 
Customize your gear, squad up, and see why VAIL has 4.8 stars across 67K reviews.

title: Devil's Roulette  -The Pit-
description: Devil's Roulette -The Pit- is a thrilling VR party game for 1 to 8 players, featuring a variety of high-stakes game modes including the new mode 'Devil's Spoons', where the player who collects four matching cards gets to pull the trigger Russian Roulette, Spin the Bottle, card-based bluffing, and more. Ready to go feral?

title: Gym Class
description: GYM CLASS is the top VR sports (🏀 basketball, 🥊 boxing, 🏈 football, ⚽soccer, ⚾ baseball, 🎨 paintball) game. Experience NBA licensed team courts & jerseys, MLB licensed ballparks & uniforms, multiplayer games, simulation physics, and massive worlds. Rated best on Quest - make friends or level-up to be the best among millions in the top VR sports community.

title: VRChat
description: Make Friends and Explore an Endless Stream of Community Made Worlds and Avatars

title: BIG BALLERS '26
description:
🏆 The #1 all-in-one VR Sports Game.

🐐 BECOME THE G.O.A.T 🐐

🎖️ Begin your legacy in BIG BALLERS VR. Play with up to 10 players and perform crazy windmill contact dunks in basketball, slug dingers in baseball, and clutch it with game-winning touchdown catches.

🏈 EASY TO LEARN – HARD TO MASTER ⚾️🏀🏐

Our world-class physics engine gives you realistic natural gameplay while being easy to grasp yet challenging to master.

😤 WILL YOU RISE TO THE CHALLENGE? 😤

title: GRAB
description: Experience the thrill of VR platforming in GRAB, where you can parkour through user-created levels with friends and build your own.
supported_devices: Quest 2 | Quest Pro | Quest 3 | Quest 3S | Quest

title: Roblox
description: Roblox lets you explore and share experiences with friends. With over 66 million daily active users and a huge variety of 3D immersive experiences created by a global community, there’s always something new to discover.

title: DOWNSHOT
description: VR’s Most Popular Multiplayer Physics Sandbox (with Mod Support!). Let your imagination run wild in our experimental physics playground of 200+ items and endless mod maps, all playable in multiplayer! Best part? It’s FREE!

title: Sail
description:
Sail the seas with friends in this FREE multiplayer VR Pirate Game! 🏴‍☠️

Battle enemy ships, board vessels, loot cargo, and claim the ocean as your own. VR ship physics let you man the sails, fire cannons, and feel the waves all with your hands. 

Gather your crew, set a course, and become the most feared pirates in VR ⚓🏴‍☠️
supported_devices: Quest 2 | Quest Pro | Quest 3 | Quest 3S | Quest

title: Gun Raiders
description:
Gun Raiders is a free-to-play VR shooter! Chat with friends while mowing down enemies in multiple game modes while jetpacking through the air or climbing from wall to wall monkey-style! Race to the top of the leaderboards while customizing yourself with crazy meme skins. Now with Battle Royale and mobile cross play!

Play through 100 levels of loot in our newest Season 15: Beyond Battle Pass and earn up to 500 Raider Coins free. Join our Discord for tournament info, giveaways, and more!
supported_devices: Quest 2 | Quest Pro | Quest 3 | Quest 3S | Quest

title: 에픽 롤러 코스터
description: Epic Roller Coasters는 세계에서 가장 독특한 롤러코스터를 찾을 수 있는 곳입니다. 공룡 시대, 중세 시대, 공상 과학 도시 등과 같이 이전에는 롤러 코스터를 타는 것을 상상할 수 없었던 곳에서 고공을 휘저으며 빠르게 질주하는 아드레날린을 느껴보세요. 클래식, 슈팅, 레이스의 세 가지 모드가 있습니다.

title: Battle Talent Demo
description:
Battle Talent is a challenging physics-based roguelite sword-fighting game.

Tired of fighting boring enemies? Battle Talent has created for you a mega seamless procedural dungeon. The full version with over 80 enemy variants, 100 weapons, 60 perks, and multiple landscapes that change each time.
supported_devices: Quest | Quest 2 | Quest Pro | Quest 3 | Quest 3S
